Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: AI agents are rapidly maturing as open-source frameworks hit a major production milestone with tripled adoption. Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups, making tool-calling reliability the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms transition from early demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and new observability standards emerge to trace agent decisions end to end.
